parsed.seniority_signal: Idealerweise hast du bereits 3–5 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, im AI Engineering oder Machine Learning gearbeitet.
parsed.degree_signal: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Bereich ist willkommen – ebenso eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch Praxiserfahrung.
parsed.notes:
Only Überzeugende Voraussetzungen supplies candidate requirements; responsibilities and benefits were excluded.
Large Language Models and Generative AI collapse into llms.
Generic Deployment, Sicherheit and Produktivbetrieb are read literally as software practices, not automatically as AI deployment, data privacy or MLOps.
AI Engineering has no exact taxonomy entry; it is an optional experience area under Idealerweise.
The degree is provisionally required because willkommen is not among the guide's specified optional markers; flagged because it can also convey a preference. Praxiserfahrung explicitly substitutes for the degree.
The preferred 3–5 years provides the inferred mid-level signal; no level is stated.
